title: Cosmic Sorcerer on Bridge
description: A purple-skinned sorcerer in a pink and white fur-trimmed robe stands on a stone bridge, holding a staff topped with a transparent bubble containing a colorful octopus-like creature with one large eye. Above, a cracked celestial moon face with three eyes looms in a starry sky filled with constellations, glowing orbs, and floating pink petals, while the bridge overlooks a swirling cosmic sea of galaxies with colorful dripping paint effects.
prompt: A purple-skinned sorcerer wearing a long pink and white fur-trimmed robe and a tall hat stands on an ornate stone bridge, holding a tall staff with a large transparent bubble at the top containing a vibrant multi-colored octopus creature with one large eye. In the starry night sky above, a giant cracked purple moon with three glowing yellow eyes and a face looks down, surrounded by constellations, glowing yarn balls, and floating pink petals. The bridge overlooks a swirling cosmic ocean of colorful galaxies and nebulae with vibrant paint dripping down from the bridge, in a highly detailed surreal fantasy style.
